ordered_diagnoses: Connective tissue disease-associated interstitial lung disease

s1.syndrome_frame: subacute onset of respiratory symptoms in a patient with a history of rheumatologic disease and recent initiation of immunosuppressive therapy
salient_findings: ground-glass interstitial infiltrates on chest CT
key_facts: 41-year-old woman
3-month history of sacroiliac pain, arthralgias, and lower-limb myalgias
partial response to NSAIDs
diagnosed with seronegative spondyloarthropathy
negative HLA-B27
bilateral active sacroiliitis on MRI
initiated weekly subcutaneous etanercept 50 mg
significant improvement in joint symptoms
developed respiratory symptoms after the third dose of etanercept
no fever, hemoptysis, chest pain, or other systemic symptoms
afebrile, normal oxygenation on room air
scant basal 'Velcro'-like crackles on pulmonary auscultation
normal laboratory studies except for mild eosinophilia
high-resolution chest CT showed ground-glass interstitial infiltrates
bronchoscopy with bronchoalveolar lavage revealed no endobronchial lesions
